notes: The tuition figure of EUR 2 902 per year comes from the Campus France Maroc page about the differentiated tuition fees ("droits d'inscription différenciés") for extra-community students, which mentions "Licence" but not "BUT"; the Parcoursup page for this programme shows only the EU rate ("Par année 178 euros.") and no non-EU rate, so the 2 902 EUR figure is a general institution-wide figure that may not exactly apply to this programme and needs checking with the establishment. The requirement "Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2" is stated on the Parcoursup page for this BUT, not on a page about foreign-diploma applicants — the Campus France Maroc pages (which cover Moroccan candidates) only say the French certification is "honorary" recommended, so the B2 requirement is a manual cross-check. No dated non-EU application deadline is given: the only dated deadline on the pages (Du 1er octobre 2026 au 15 novembre 2026) applies to the ADIUT Maroc 1ère année BUT procedure, not specifically to this programme; no documents list is given for this programme.
